title: retry step error message swallowed in host
notes: When a New-Step -Retry block throws, the error message (innerMessage) is swallowed in the catch block. Only '[>] Retrying in Xs...' is written to host. Fix: add Write-Host '[!] \' in red before the retry line in the catch block of the do/while retry loop in Public/New-Step.ps1 (~line 1013). The Write-StepperLog call already captures it, just not the host output.

title: Phase 7: invoke ConvertTo-StepperScript from New-Step first-run with once-only sentinel
description: During New-Step first-run, after Repair-StepperScript completes, check whether a sentinel variable (\) already exists in the script. If absent and cross-step variable candidates exist (via Find-CrossStepVariables), invoke ConvertTo-StepperScript interactively. ConvertTo-StepperScript injects \ = \True into the script after rewriting, acting as the sentinel. The script itself is the record of conversion -- no sidecar files, no state-file keys. TDD: tests first. See ADR 0011.

title: Phase 6: New-StepperScript public function
description: Create Public/New-StepperScript.ps1. ByPath and ByName+Directory parameter sets. Minimal template by default; -Showcase switch (aliases: -Full, -Detailed, -WithExamples) for feature-demo template. -Force to overwrite. Returns [System.IO.FileInfo]. TDD: tests first.

title: Phase 4: Refactor New-Step first-run to call Repair-StepperScript
description: Replace Test-StepperScriptRequirements call in New-Step.ps1 first-run block with Repair-StepperScript. Convert Test-StepperScriptRequirements to deprecated shim. Run full pester suite for regression.

title: Phase 5: Convert-StepperScript public function
description: Create Public/Convert-StepperScript.ps1. Uses Find-CrossStepVariables to detect candidates, presents interactive selection, rewrites \ to \.Var inside New-Step bodies via back-to-front AST offset rewriting. -OutputPath param, in-place+.bak default. SupportsShouldProcess. TDD: tests first.

title: Phase 3: Repair-StepperScript public function
description: Create Public/Repair-StepperScript.ps1. Calls Test-StepperScript internally. Fixes: MissingCmdletBinding, MissingInstallGuard, MissingCbh (silent via Add-StepperCbh). Reports-only: MissingStopStepper, NoSteps. SupportsShouldProcess. Returns post-fix Test-StepperScript result. TDD: tests first.
close_reason: Repair-StepperScript implemented, all 9 tests passing. Fixes CmdletBinding, InstallGuard, Cbh. Warns on MissingStopStepper/NoSteps. SupportsShouldProcess/-WhatIf tested.

title: Phase 2: Test-StepperScript public function

title: Phase 1: Add-StepperCbh private helper
description: Create Private/Add-StepperCbh.ps1. Inspects script AST for existing CBH. If absent: insert full CBH block. If present but no .NOTES: append .NOTES. If .NOTES exists: append Stepper usage blurb. Silent (no Write-Host). Returns bool. TDD: tests first.
close_reason: Add-StepperCbh implemented, all 8 tests passing. Handles no-CBH, no-.NOTES, existing-.NOTES, already-present cases. Silent.

title: Phase 1: Find-CrossStepVariables private helper
description: Create Private/Find-CrossStepVariables.ps1. AST-walks New-Step scriptblock bodies, identifies vars written in one step and read in a later step. Excludes PS automatic vars and existing \.* vars. Returns [string[]] of var names. TDD: tests first.
close_reason: Find-CrossStepVariables implemented and all 12 tests passing. Root fix: PS enumerates HashSets on +=, fixed with , prefix.

title: replace #requires check with less aggressive checking mechanism
Implement exponential backoff retry in New-Step
description: Add -Retry, -RetryInterval, -MaxRetries params to New-Step (Public/New-Step.ps1) per GitHub issue #38. Wrap ScriptBlock execution in a retry loop with exponential backoff. Route retry events through Write-StepperLog. Handle partial transcripts per failed attempt, dual elapsed time reporting, and ValidateRange on interval/maxretries params.
design: MaxRetries=N means N retries after initial attempt (N+1 total executions). Wait formula: RetryInterval * 2^attempt. Transcript: [PARTIAL] per failed attempt, clean section on success. Elapsed: report final-attempt time + total wall time when retries occurred. Orphaned params (RetryInterval/MaxRetries without -Retry) emit Write-Warning. ValidateRange: both params >= 1. Max cap deferred to separate issue.
close_reason: Implementation complete with all 83 Pester tests passing
